university.name: SOAS University of London
university.summary: SOAS University of London has its address at 10 Thornhaugh Street, Russell Square, London. It publishes entry guidance for applicants from Pakistan, offers a pre-master's programme, and lists master's scholarships open to overseas fee-paying students.

courses.title: International Business
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (part time also offered)
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's in the School of Finance and Management covering multinational business, international management, strategy and human resource management, completed with a dissertation or an industry project plus a research project.
courses.academic_requirements: We will consider all applications with 2:2 (or international equivalent) or higher. A supporting statement and business related work experience are also considered. References are optional.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no scores. The SOAS English language requirements page lists direct entry as IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills, PTE Academic 65 overall with 60 in all skills, TOEFL iBT 95 overall, Duolingo 120 overall with 110 in SWRL. Composite scores such as TOEFL MyBest are not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Course page: bachelor's degree (4-year) from an HEC recognised institution, or 2-year BA plus 2-year MA from an HEC recognised institution, equivalent to 2:2 at CGPA 2.7 or 55%. Pakistan country page: First Division or CGPA 3.0 or 60% for listed universities, or First Division or CGPA 3.3 or 65% for other NARIC/HEC approved institutions. The two pages differ.
courses.notes: Course page says start is September with no year, so no intake label recorded. Fee of GBP 26,000 appears on the course page without a year and matches the 2026/27 Finance and Management band on the fees page; the 2027/28 figure for that band is not listed. Module list on the course page is indicative with no academic year stated. English scores are from the general SOAS page, programme specific level not stated. Pakistan thresholds differ between course page and country page, so pk fields left null.

courses.title: International Studies and Diplomacy
courses.duration_text: 1 year full time (part time also offered)
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's in the Department of Politics and International Studies combining diplomatic practice and general diplomatic studies with optional modules on international law, politics, security and development, and a dissertation.
highlights: Compulsory: Dissertation in Politics and International Studies
courses.academic_requirements: We will consider all applications with 2:2 (or international equivalent) or higher. Applicants are also assessed on the supporting statement. References are optional.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no scores. The SOAS English language requirements page lists direct entry as IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills, PTE Academic 65 overall with 60 in all skills, TOEFL iBT 95 overall, Duolingo 120 overall with 110 in SWRL. Composite scores such as TOEFL MyBest are not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Course page: bachelor's degree (4-year) from an HEC recognised institution, or 2-year BA plus 2-year MA from an HEC recognised institution, equivalent to 2:2 at CGPA 2.7 or 55%. Pakistan country page: First Division or CGPA 3.0 or 60% for listed universities, or First Division or CGPA 3.3 or 65% for other NARIC/HEC approved institutions. The two pages differ.
courses.notes: Course page says start is September with no year, so no intake label recorded. Fee of GBP 29,990 is the 2027/28 figure for the International Studies and Diplomacy band on the fees page; the course page shows GBP 28,840 (the 2026/27 figure) without a year. Module list is indicative with no academic year stated. English scores are from the general SOAS page, programme specific level not stated. Pakistan thresholds differ between course page and country page, so pk fields left null.

courses.title: Economics
courses.overview: A full-time undergraduate economics degree at SOAS (UCAS code L100) with first year study of macro and micro economic principles, statistics and mathematics for economists, plus guided options.
highlights: Compulsory: Applied Economic Issues in the Global Economy
courses.academic_requirements: A Levels ABB (contextualised offer BBB), with minimum grade B in A Level maths or equivalent. The page lists A Level equivalents for about 40 countries; none specific to Pakistan was seen on the course page.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no scores. The SOAS English language requirements page lists direct entry as IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all skills, PTE Academic 65 overall with 60 in all skills, TOEFL iBT 95 overall, Duolingo 120 overall with 110 in SWRL. Composite scores such as TOEFL MyBest are not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page: the Pakistan High School leaving certificate is not sufficient for entry to a SOAS undergraduate degree; applicants can instead take the SOAS IFCELS preparatory year. A completed BA or BComm from a Pakistani university is welcome at Division I (60% or above).
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 23,780 is the 2026/27 overseas fee and the undergraduate fees page shows no later year. Course page says start is September with no year, so no intake label recorded. Module list is indicative. English scores are from the general SOAS page, programme specific level not stated. Fee may rise by up to 5% in later years of study on the same degree, per the fees page.

scholarships.name: SOAS Master's Scholarships (International)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 8,000 fee waiver; for two-year programmes it covers the first year's fees only
scholarships.summary: Fee waiver for overseas fee-paying students holding an offer for a full-time on campus taught master's. The published page states over 150 awards for the 2026/27 academic year.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee-paying; offer for a full-time on campus postgraduate taught programme; UK 2:1 or international equivalent; no other SOAS scholarship or full-fee funding; joint partnership programmes excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: Published 2026/27 rounds closed 28 February, 30 April and 30 June 2026. 2027/28 dates not yet published. A GBP 4,000 CAS deposit is payable by award holders.
scholarships.notes: Terms are for 2026/27 entry and the round is closed; the 2027 edition is not yet published. Page lists no eligible countries beyond overseas fee status.

scholarships.name: SOAS International Academic Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Up to 25 full fee waivers and up to eight GBP 20,000 fee waivers; for two-year programmes it applies to the first year only
scholarships.summary: Fee waivers for overseas fee-paying students with an offer for a full-time on campus taught master's. The page states up to 33 awards and no restriction by country.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for a full-time postgraduate taught programme on campus; overseas fee-paying; UK 2:1 or international equivalent.
scholarships.deadline_note: Published deadline was 12 noon UK time on 29 May 2026; the form opened January 2026. 2027/28 dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Page does not state an entry year; the dates shown are 2026. The postgraduate taught scholarships listing shows the award as Closed.

scholarships.name: SOAS GREAT Scholarships: Indonesia and Pakistan
scholarships.provider_name: SOAS University of London with the British Council (GREAT Scholarships)
scholarships.summary: Fee waiver for Pakistani passport holders with an offer for a one-year full-time on campus taught master's. The page states two awards shared between Indonesia and Pakistan for September 2026 entry.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pakistani passport; pays overseas fees; offer for a one-year full-time on campus postgraduate taught programme. Part-time and two-year programmes are not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: Published deadline 11:59pm BST on 24 May 2026. A GBP 4,000 CAS deposit is payable by winners. 2027 edition not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms are for September 2026 entry and the postgraduate taught scholarships listing shows the award as Closed. The page URL contains 2025 entry but the page content states 2026. A separate SOAS International Postgraduate Scholarship for Pakistan is mentioned on the Pakistan country page, but its own page could not be fetched and it is not on the PGT listing, so it is excluded.
